description:
Read one full TraderMatrix learn page as markdown. Accepts a slug ("heat-map"),
an id ("concept:new-money"), a page URL, or a .md URL. Use after search_learn when the
user needs the whole explanation. Returns the markdown plus title, url, toolUrl (the
live tool to open) and related pages.
